articles.title: Binance to resume withdrawals after recovering 95% of $6.3 billion crypto theft

The FBI is investigating the cyberattack, linking it to a North Korean hacking group named TraderTraitor.

articles.title: No GPS, no permits: Tamil Nadu bars mineral transport vehicles without tracking devices from Nov 1
articles.description: No vehicles will be allowed to transport minerals without GPS devices installed by November 1. The devices must be integrated with the state's MiMAS portal for real-time location tracking. Currently, around 1.10 lakh vehicles are registered, but only 50,000 actively transport minerals. Lorry owners must purchase devices from approved vendors, with costs now around ₹4000. Failure to comply will result in legal action against lorry owners.

articles.title: Walmart shopper's $975,000 verdict tossed over lawyer's $8,000 fee remark
articles.description: A Georgia woman who won $975,000 after a fall at a Walmart store in 2020 will face a new trial after an appeals court overturned the verdict on October 29. The court found that her lawyer had improperly compared compensation for pain and suffering with an expert witness's $8,000 daily fee and minimum-wage rates. Judges ruled that these unrelated comparisons could have influenced the jury's decision.

articles.title: 117-year-old US basilica reopens after $7.7m restoration; more work ahead
articles.description: The historic basilica in Asheville, North Carolina, recently marked the successful completion of its first restoration phase, costing $7.7 million. This essential initiative concentrated on addressing water damage and safeguarding the architectural masterpiece. Key upgrades included the replacement of the copper dome and reinforcing key masonry sections, paving the way for future restoration phases that rely on ongoing fundraising efforts and the building's status as a cultural treasure.

articles.title: ‘Binance will absorb the impact, not users’: Crypto exchange sets aside $6.34 billion to cover hack losses
articles.description: Binance has encountered a serious security breach, with $6.3 billion in digital assets being stolen. To safeguard its users, the exchange will utilize its Secure Asset Fund for Users to absorb the losses. Collaborating with law enforcement, approximately $3 billion in stolen cryptocurrency has been successfully frozen across multiple blockchains.
